name: JTBD1 — Least-recently-used views via search-content
description: Stale-content JTBD via the content-exploration path (not Admin Insights). Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model should use search-content scoped to views, ordering by usage (hitsTotal ascending) to surface the least-recently-used Superstore views. Read-only.
prompt: Find the least-recently-used Superstore views on this site. Use the search-content tool scoped to views, ordered by total usage ascending. Report the view names and LUIDs. Do not modify or delete anything.
